family = 'multiple_ranges'

    def check(family):
        cases = [c for c in CASES if c["family"] == family]
        assert cases, f"no cases for {family}"
        failures = []
        for case in cases:
            path = workdir(case)
            try:
                want = run([GNU_SED], case, path)
                got = run(DEMOTE + CANDIDATE, case, path)
